systems.name: AnimalFactory
systems.summary: Makes the world's physical animal from its AnimalSpawn: loads body, params and ranges, builds the ragdoll, configures AgentIO, starts the first episode.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: Created in preinit; configured with the body's behaviour, observation and action sizes and the nogail_order sensor; action, reward, done, truncated, stats cleared by the reset.

access.name: AnimalSpawn
access.effect: What animal to make (the first entity with one).

access.name: WalkRoutes
access.effect: Copied into the bot for spawn points and headings on a terrain.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Created and filled; finish destroys its ragdoll.

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: std::shared_ptr<GroundField> kept as the bot's ground.

access.name: AgentEnvParams
access.effect: Trainer overrides of the params file.

access.name: TerrainColliders
access.effect: Presence only: LinearCast bodies and TerrainUsers set.

access.name: TerrainUsers
access.effect: The ragdoll's bodies, so WorldTerrain builds colliders under them.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Ragdoll bodies and constraints created, placed, destroyed.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Soft depth, yaw, spawn point, command and order draws.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Unparks the world.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: On the drawn shape entities.

access.name: WorldShape
access.effect: One per shape of every segment, for WorldView.

access.name: ModelRef
access.effect: Colour of a drawn shape.

side_effects: Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.

systems.name: AnimalDrive
systems.summary: Act phase: the window's action (8 values a joint) as motor gains, targets and target velocities of the ragdoll's constraints; a zero action holds the standing pose.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Drives and limits of the body; decisions, window_ticks, target_clamps updated.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: The action written by TrainerActions.

side_effects: Sets motor settings, states, friction and targets of the ragdoll's Jolt constraints.

systems.name: AnimalSoftGround
systems.summary: Soft ground: a drag on the segments inside the soft layer, full sideways, a part upwards, none downwards. Before PhysicsStep.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Segment states, soft depth, params, body and ground.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: AddForce on the segments' bodies.

side_effects: Adds forces to the ragdoll's Jolt bodies.

systems.name: AnimalSync
systems.summary: After PhysicsStep: the segments' states and origin velocities into the AnimalBot, tick counters, the drawn shapes moved.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Segment states, origin velocities, tick, window_ticks.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Bodies' positions, rotations and velocities.

access.name: WorldShape
access.effect: Segment and local pose of a drawn shape.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: World pose of the drawn shape.

access.name: PhysicsPose
access.effect: Last two poses of the drawn shape for WorldView.

systems.name: AnimalTask
systems.summary: Advances the physical animal's WalkCommand (drawn from GaitRanges, headings from the routes on a terrain) and, with orders, the mode and head offsets.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: command, route_lost, mode, head, order_until.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Command, heading and order draws.

systems.name: AnimalTermination
systems.summary: Ends the episode by a fall (killed, world parked) or by time or a lost route (truncated).

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Fall test; killed, fall_cause, fall_segment, truncated.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: dt: the episode length in ticks.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Parks the world on a fall.

systems.name: AnimalRewards
systems.summary: Observe phase: the window's reward (speed along the command, head and mode with orders), the trainer's stats, the episode record; resets the episode when one is due.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Rating inputs; episode, cumulative_reward; the whole episode state on a reset.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: reset_requested read and cleared; reward and stats written; action, done, truncated cleared on a reset.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: dt of the window.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Spawn, yaw, soft depth, command and order draws.

access.name: AgentEnvParams
access.effect: Trainer overrides of the params.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: The bodies placed in the standing pose.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Unparks the world.

side_effects: Teleports the ragdoll's Jolt bodies on a reset.
Logs a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.

systems.name: AnimalObservation
systems.summary: Observe phase: the stacked observation (header + 9 values a segment, twice), the order sensor, the decision snapshot, the recordable flag of demonstrations.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: State read; snapshots, previous_frame, recorded written.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: observation, sensors[0] (nogail_order), recordable written.

systems.name: AnimalEpisode
systems.summary: Observe phase: done and truncated for the trainer, the episode record closed (kept in eval), the reset scheduled and the world parked.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: fresh, truncated, episode, episodes, pending_reset.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: done, truncated.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Parks the world at the end of an episode.

systems.name: AnimalGaitPlayer
systems.summary: Plays the procedural walk (GaitWalk) on the kinematic ragdoll following its own WalkCommand: the demonstrations. Before PhysicsStep.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Ground (a plane when none), demo_restart, walks, soft_depth, origin, command, decision counters, warm_left, recorded, history_valid.

access.name: AnimalWalkState
access.effect: The walk and run, blended pose, bind, readiness.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Run or walk, style, heading, phase, warm-up, command draws.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: tick and decision_period: windows and warm-up.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Teleports or moves the kinematic bodies.

side_effects: Reads the species' files from the animal library in init.
Moves the ragdoll's kinematic Jolt bodies every tick.
Logs an error when the walk cannot be played.

systems.name: AnimalChecks
systems.summary: Checks a recording on the body: joint limits, lowest point, falls, stretch, foot slide, observation jumps, heading flips, speed against the command.

access.name: AnimalDemoChecks
access.effect: The measures.

access.name: AnimalBot
access.effect: Segment states, body, snapshot, command, recorded, warm_left.

access.name: AnimalWalkState
access.effect: Which gait plays and its planted feet.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: tick, decision_period, dt.

components.name: AnimalSpawn
components.summary: The scene entity asking for a physical animal: body, params, ranges, gait and how the episode runs.

fields.name: body
fields.desc: A body file, or a species id (the library's bodies folder); required.

fields.name: params
fields.desc: Params file under resources/ (default agents/params/animal.params.json).

fields.name: ranges
fields.desc: GaitRanges file: commands and demonstration styles (default agents/ranges/walk_basic.json).

fields.name: gait
fields.desc: Clip of the kinematic walk: walk, trot or run (default walk).

fields.name: kinematic
fields.desc: The procedural walk is played on the body (demonstrations); JSON key motion: dynamic | kinematic.

fields.name: recording
fields.desc: Observations are recorded walks (demonstrations).

fields.name: draw
fields.desc: WorldShape entities for WorldView.

fields.name: view
fields.desc: No end of episode by time.

fields.name: view_truncate
fields.desc: ... but episodes truncated as in training, and kept (eval).

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: > 0: this command straight ahead, in speeds of the walk clip, instead of draws (default 0).

fields.name: recording_decisions
fields.desc: Recorded decisions per walk (default 300).

fields.name: warmup
fields.desc: Seconds walked before a walk is recorded, plus up to a cycle (default 2).

fields.name: heading
fields.desc: >= 0: recorded walks start with this heading in degrees (0 looks down -z); else drawn (default -1).

fields.name: soft_depth
fields.desc: >= 0: this depth of soft ground in heights instead of the ranges' draw (default -1).

fields.name: orders
fields.desc: Modes and head offsets drawn next to the commands, the nogail_order sensor on (default false).

components.notes: Read by AnimalFactory in init (the first entity only); registered by registerAnimalAgents, which rejects an empty body, a motion other than dynamic/kinematic and an unknown gait. AnimalBot keeps a copy (spawn).

components.name: AnimalBot
components.summary: A physical animal: its body, params, ranges, ragdoll, segment states, command, order, episode state and records.

fields.name: body
fields.desc: The loaded body file.

fields.name: base_params
fields.desc: The params file as loaded.

fields.name: params
fields.desc: The params with the world's AgentEnvParams over them (applied at init and every reset).

fields.name: ranges
fields.desc: Commands, styles, idle/run parts, soft ground draws.

fields.name: ranges_hash
fields.desc: SHA-256 of the ranges file.

fields.name: spawn
fields.desc: Copy of the spawn component.

fields.name: kinematic, recording, draw, view, view_truncate
fields.desc: Copied from the spawn.

fields.name: built
fields.desc: The ragdoll exists; every system returns while false.

fields.name: immortal
fields.desc: The standing test: no end by falling.

fields.name: limp
fields.desc: Motors off (standing test).

fields.name: parts
fields.desc: Jolt bodies and constraints of the ragdoll.

fields.name: position, linear, angular
fields.desc: World position, linear and angular velocity per segment (AnimalSync).

fields.name: rotation
fields.desc: World rotation per segment.

fields.name: origin_previous, origin_velocity
fields.desc: Finite differences of the segments' origins (the velocities observed and rewarded).

fields.name: history_valid
fields.desc: origin_previous is usable (false after a teleport).

fields.name: command
fields.desc: The command of the task or of the recorded walk.

fields.name: snapshot_trunk, snapshot_direction
fields.desc: Trunk position and command direction at the last decision.

fields.name: snapshot_speed
fields.desc: Command speed at the last decision.

fields.name: orders
fields.desc: Orders on (spawn.orders).

fields.name: mode
fields.desc: AnimalMode asked: Move, Feed, Attack, Mate, Rest.

fields.name: head
fields.desc: Head yaw (left) and pitch (up) asked, radians from standing.

fields.name: order_until
fields.desc: Command time at which the next order is drawn.

fields.name: snapshot_mode, snapshot_head
fields.desc: The order at the last decision.

fields.name: head_segment
fields.desc: Index of the head segment (findHead).

fields.name: muzzle
fields.desc: Front of the head in the head segment's frame.

fields.name: head_stand
fields.desc: Head direction standing, in the trunk's heading frame.

fields.name: muzzle_stand
fields.desc: Muzzle height standing, m.

fields.name: neck
fields.desc: Per segment: head and neck up to the shoulders.

fields.name: neck_may_touch
fields.desc: With orders the neck may touch the ground (feeding).

fields.name: frame_size
fields.desc: 7 + 9 x segments.

fields.name: previous_frame
fields.desc: The older half of the stacked observation.

fields.name: tick, decisions, window_ticks
fields.desc: Ticks of the episode, decisions, ticks of the current window.

fields.name: killed, truncated, pending_reset, fresh
fields.desc: Episode end flags; reset due at the next observe phase; episode just started.

fields.name: fall_cause, fall_segment
fields.desc: 1 trunk too low, 2 a body touched; the segment.

fields.name: cumulative_reward
fields.desc: Sum of the episode's rewards.

fields.name: target_clamps
fields.desc: Drive targets Jolt clamped to the joint cones.

fields.name: soft_depth
fields.desc: This episode's soft ground depth, m.

fields.name: demo_restart
fields.desc: The gait player starts a new walk at its next tick.

fields.name: warm_left, recorded
fields.desc: Warm-up ticks left; recorded decisions of the walk.

fields.name: walks
fields.desc: Walks started by the gait player.

fields.name: ground
fields.desc: The world's ground field, null on the flat ground prefab (heights from y = 0).

fields.name: routes
fields.desc: Slope band of spawn points and headings on a terrain.

fields.name: origin
fields.desc: This episode's spawn point.

fields.name: route_lost
fields.desc: No heading in the band: the episode is truncated.

fields.name: episode
fields.desc: The episode in progress: ticks, fell, cause, segment, distance, progress, commanded, heading error, soft depth, per kind of command.

fields.name: episodes
fields.desc: Finished episodes (view_truncate, eval); read and cleared by TrainHost::evalAnimals.

components.notes: World context variable of the single animal worlds, created by AnimalFactory in init; ragdoll destroyed in its finish. Read by TrainHost (src/train/animal_host.cpp). Also a component on the sandbox's animals (SandboxAnimal entities, docs/action-agents.md), driven by the same free functions (buildAnimalRagdoll, standAnimalBot, driveAnimalBot, syncAnimalBot, rateAnimal).

components.name: AnimalWalkState
components.summary: The procedural walk the gait player plays on the kinematic body (demonstrations).

fields.name: walk
fields.desc: The walk (or the spawn's gait) as a GaitWalk.

fields.name: run
fields.desc: The run of ranges that run, when the animal has one.

fields.name: has_run
fields.desc: run is set up.

fields.name: running
fields.desc: This recorded walk is a run from end to end.

fields.name: blended
fields.desc: Pose blended toward standing as a command halts.

fields.name: plane
fields.desc: A PlaneField when the world has no ground field.

fields.name: ready
fields.desc: The walk can be played.

fields.name: problem
fields.desc: Why not (no animal, not kinematic, no such clip, unreadable clip).

fields.name: bind
fields.desc: The body bound to the species' skeleton.

components.notes: Created by AnimalGaitPlayer in init; read by AnimalChecks, by TrainHost::animalDemoProblem and by the AA tests.

components.name: AnimalDemoChecks
components.summary: What a recording of the procedural walk on the body is checked for.

fields.name: ticks, decisions
fields.desc: Checked ticks and decisions.

fields.name: limit_excess
fields.desc: Radians: the furthest a joint was outside its limits.

fields.name: limit_joint
fields.desc: That joint.

fields.name: limit_ticks
fields.desc: Ticks with a joint more than 0.5 degree outside.

fields.name: axis_jump
fields.desc: Largest change of an observed axis between two decisions.

fields.name: velocity_jump
fields.desc: ... of an observed velocity, in walk speeds.

fields.name: axis_jumps
fields.desc: Decisions where an observed axis changed by more than 0.6.

fields.name: heading_flips
fields.desc: Decisions where the heading turned by more than 60 degrees.

fields.name: lowest
fields.desc: m: lowest point of a body over the hard ground.

fields.name: falls
fields.desc: Ticks the fall test would have ended the episode.

fields.name: fall_cause, fall_segment
fields.desc: Of the last such tick.

fields.name: axis_segment, velocity_segment, lowest_segment
fields.desc: Segments of the worst values.

fields.name: progress, commanded
fields.desc: m along the commanded heading, and asked for.

fields.name: speed_error
fields.desc: Worst |progress / commanded - 1| over a recorded walk.

fields.name: stretch
fields.desc: m: furthest a segment's origin was from its joint.

fields.name: foot_slide
fields.desc: m/s: 99th percentile speed of planted feet.

fields.name: kind_decisions
fields.desc: Recorded decisions whose command stands, walks, runs.

fields.name: idle_distance
fields.desc: m covered while the command stood.

fields.name: slides
fields.desc: Planted foot speeds (for foot_slide).

fields.name: walk_progress, walk_commanded
fields.desc: The same for the current walk.

fields.name: previous
fields.desc: The last recorded frame.

components.notes: Created by AnimalChecks in preinit, filled in its tick. json() is what TrainHost::writeAnimalChecks logs (demo checks ...) and writes to the scene variable checks.
